title: 第五章太白临凡 三考验心第六章 黄沙迷阵 骨妖作祟
content_zh:
辞别黑风岭，四人踏月西行，一路穿林越涧，步履沉稳。
经四大天王传法，又在黑风寨与群妖恶战一场，宁洋北、王学南、张忠东、陈学西四人，对自身本源神力的掌控愈发娴熟，彼此间的默契也愈发深厚。夜色渐淡，东方天际泛起一抹鱼肚白，晨雾缭绕山间，草木沾露，空气清新，一扫昨夜厮杀的血腥戾气。
脚下山路渐趋平缓，两侧林木葱郁，鸟鸣声声，与黑风岭的阴森诡谲截然不同，反倒透着几分祥和安宁。四人一路疾行，天色大亮之时，已然行至一处山清水秀的谷地。
谷地之中，良田错落，溪流潺潺，隐约可见几间茅屋散落其间，炊烟袅袅，本该是一派世外桃源般的田园盛景，可细看之下，却透着几分萧瑟。田地里庄稼稀疏，不见农人劳作，茅屋门户紧闭，偶有几声犬吠，也显得有气无力，全然没有寻常村落的生机。
王学南脚步微顿，指尖轻掐，眉头缓缓舒展，又随即蹙起：“此地地气平和，无半分妖邪煞气，却透着一股困顿之气，想来是受天下瘟疫波及，村落百姓多有染病，才这般冷清。”
宁洋北闻言，心中悲悯顿生，望着空旷的田地，轻声叹道：“瘟疫肆虐，天下百姓皆受其苦，无论山川险地，还是田园村落，都难躲此劫，我们更要早日西行，寻回玉盘，解救苍生。”
张忠东握紧手中火焰灵杖，语气坚定：“不错，越早抵达西天，百姓便能少受一日苦难，我们加快脚步，穿过这处谷地。”
陈学西默然点头，目光扫过谷地四周，虽未察觉凶险，却依旧保持着警惕，周身白虎杀伐之气内敛，随时应对突发变故。
四人加快脚步，沿着谷地中的小径前行，行至半路，忽闻前方传来微弱的啜泣声，声音稚嫩，满是无助与悲伤，在这寂静的谷地中，格外清晰。
“前方有人。”宁洋北神色一动，率先迈步，朝着哭声传来的方向走去。
转过一片低矮的灌木丛，只见溪流旁的青石上，坐着一个约莫五六岁的孩童。孩童身着打满补丁的粗布衣衫，头发枯黄，面容瘦弱，一双大眼睛哭得通红，小手抹着眼泪，肩膀不停抽泣，身旁放着一个破旧的竹篮，里面空空如也。
四人连忙上前，宁洋北放缓语气，轻声问道：“小娃娃，你为何独自一人在此哭泣？你的家人呢？”
孩童抬头，泪眼婆娑地看着四人，抽噎着说道：“我……我爹娘都染了病，躺在床上动弹不得，我想上山采些野菜回去给他们充饥，可……可我找不到野菜，还把自己迷路了，我怕爹娘有事，我想回家……”
话音未落，孩童又忍不住大哭起来，声音哽咽，听得人心头发酸。
宁洋北心中悲悯更甚，连忙蹲下身，轻轻拍着孩童的后背，柔声安抚：“莫哭莫哭，我们带你回家，再帮你照看爹娘，你可知家在何处？”
孩童闻言，哭声渐止，怯生生地指着谷地深处的一间茅屋，点了点头。
张忠东性子热忱，当即说道：“我们先送这孩子回家，再看看他爹娘的病情，能帮衬一把便帮衬一把。”
王学南与陈学西也无异议，在这苍生受难之际，但凡有能帮扶之处，四人绝不会袖手旁观。
当下，宁洋北牵着孩童的手，四人一同朝着孩童家中走去。不过半柱香功夫，便来到孩童家中，那是一间极为破旧的茅屋，土墙斑驳，屋顶茅草多处破损，推门而入，一股淡淡的药味与病气扑面而来。
屋内陈设简陋，只有一张破旧木床，床上躺着一对中年夫妻，皆是面色蜡黄，气息虚弱，咳嗽不止，正是染上了那场肆虐天下的瘟疫，已然奄奄一息。

孩童扑到床边，哭喊着爹娘，却无半分力气回应。
宁洋北见状，当即走到床边，抬手催动青龙灵珠，一丝温润的青木灵气缓缓注入夫妻二人体内。灵气所过之处，夫妻二人急促的咳嗽渐渐平缓，面色也稍稍好转，气息平稳了许多。
“多谢……多谢好心人……”床榻上的男子艰难地睁开眼，看着宁洋北，眼中满是感激。
“你们安心休养，不必多礼。”宁洋北轻声说道，随即又将四人行囊中仅剩的干粮尽数取出，放在桌上，“这些干粮你们先充饥，我们还要西行赶路，日后若有机会，定会再来看望你们。”
四人不愿多做耽搁，毕竟西行之路漫漫，多停留一刻，天下百姓便多受一刻苦难。可看着这一家三口凄惨模样，又实在放心不下，王学南又凭借自身所学，在屋内寻得几株草药，碾碎后熬成药汁，喂夫妻二人服下，又仔细叮嘱孩童照料爹娘的法子，才准备辞别离去。
就在四人转身欲走之时，屋外忽然传来一阵苍老的咳嗽声，紧接着，一个衣衫褴褛、须发花白的老者，拄着一根破旧木杖，步履蹒跚地走进屋内。
老者看起来年近古稀，衣衫破旧不堪，浑身沾满尘土，面容枯槁，眼神浑浊，双腿似乎有些不便，行走间颤颤巍巍，仿佛一阵风就能吹倒。
“几位小友，行行好，老汉几日未曾进食，又染了风寒，浑身难受，可否施舍些吃食，或是些许银两，让老汉能活命下去……”老者走到四人面前，颤声哀求，声音虚弱，满是绝望。
看着老者这般凄惨模样，张忠东当即心善，想要将仅剩的一点干粮递过去，可摸了摸行囊，方才已然将所有干粮都给了那患病夫妻，四人自己都已无吃食。
“老人家，实在对不住，我们方才将干粮都给了这对患病的夫妻，我们一路西行，也无银两在身，实在是……”张忠东面露难色，语气满是愧疚。
老者闻言，眼中绝望更甚，瘫坐在地上，放声大哭：“天要亡我啊！老汉无儿无女，又染上病痛，如今连一口吃食都求不到，不如就此死了算了！”
老者哭声凄惨，闻者心酸。宁洋北心中不忍，环顾四周，见屋外溪流中有鱼虾游动，当即说道：“老人家莫急，我们虽无干粮银两，却可以为你捕鱼充饥，再为你调理身体。”
说罢，宁洋北便带着张忠东走到溪流边，张忠东动用自身神力，卷起溪水，将鱼虾赶到岸边，宁洋北则以青木灵气护住鱼虾，小心翼翼地捕捉。王学南则在屋内寻来干柴，生火准备烹制，陈学西则守在老者身旁，防止他摔倒，又以自身白虎灵气为老者驱散体内寒气。
四人毫无怨言，忙碌许久，终于将鱼虾烹制好，一口一口喂给老者吃下。待老者吃饱，宁洋北又催动青龙灵气，为老者调理身体，缓解病痛。
老者吃饱喝足，身体也舒坦了许多，看着四人忙碌的身影，浑浊的眼中闪过一丝不易察觉的精光，随即又恢复了虚弱模样，连连道谢：“多谢四位小友，你们当真都是心善之人，老汉感激不尽。”
四人连忙摆手，称这是举手之劳。待老者气息平稳，四人再次辞别，准备继续西行。
可刚走出茅屋，便见前方路口，站着一群面色凶悍的壮汉，约莫十余人，个个手持棍棒，面色不善，将四人去路牢牢堵住。
为首的壮汉满脸横肉，眼神凶狠，盯着四人厉声喝道：“哪里来的毛头小子，竟敢在这一带多管闲事？此路是我开，此树是我栽，要想从此过，留下身上所有值钱的东西，否则，打断你们的腿！”
content_en:
Saying goodbye to Heifeng Ridge, the four of them set foot on the moon and headed westward, walking steadily through the woods and over streams.
After being taught the Dharma by the four heavenly kings and fighting a fierce battle with a group of monsters in Black Wind Village, Ning Yangbei, Wang Xuenan, Zhang Zhongdong, and Chen Xuexi became more and more skilled in controlling their original divine power, and their tacit understanding with each other became deeper and deeper. The night is fading, and a fish-belly white color appears in the eastern sky. The morning mist lingers in the mountains, the grass and trees are stained with dew, and the air is fresh, sweeping away the bloody and violent atmosphere of last night's fighting.
The mountain road at the foot gradually becomes gentle, with lush trees on both sides and the sound of birds chirping. It is completely different from the eerie and eerie Black Wind Ridge, but it reveals a bit of peace and tranquility. The four of them walked quickly, and when the sky was bright, they had already arrived at a valley with beautiful mountains and clear waters.
In the valley, there are fertile fields scattered around, gurgling streams, and a few thatched huts scattered among them, with smoke curling from the cooking stoves. It should be a pastoral scene like a paradise, but upon closer inspection, it seems a bit desolate. The crops in the fields are sparse, there are no farmers working, the doors of the huts are closed, and there are a few dogs barking occasionally, which also seems weak, and there is no vitality like an ordinary village.
Wang Xuenan paused slightly, pinched his fingertips lightly, and slowly relaxed his brows, then frowned: "The atmosphere here is peaceful, without any evil spirit, but there is an air of distress. It seems that it is affected by the plague in the world, and many people in the village are infected, so it is so deserted."
Hearing this, Ning Yangbei felt compassion in his heart. He looked at the empty fields and sighed softly: "The plague is raging, and people all over the world are suffering from it. No matter the mountains, rivers, dangerous places, or pastoral villages, it is difficult to escape this disaster. We must go west as soon as possible to find the jade plate and save the common people."
Zhang Zhongdong clenched the flaming staff in his hand and said firmly: "Yes, the sooner we arrive in the West, the less suffering the people will suffer. Let's speed up and pass through this valley."
Chen Xuexi nodded silently and glanced around the valley. Although he did not notice the danger, he still remained vigilant. The white tiger's murderous aura around him was restrained, ready to deal with unexpected changes at any time.
The four of them quickened their pace and walked along the path in the valley. Halfway there, they suddenly heard faint sobbing coming from the front. The voice was childish, full of helplessness and sadness, and it was particularly clear in this silent valley.
"There is someone ahead." Ning Yangbei's expression changed, and he took the lead and walked towards the direction where the cry came from.
After turning around a low bush, I saw a child of about five or six years old sitting on the bluestone beside the stream. The child was dressed in patched coarse clothes, with yellow hair and a thin face. His big eyes were red from crying, his little hands were wiping tears, and his shoulders were sobbing. There was an old bamboo basket beside him, which was empty.
The four people hurriedly stepped forward. Ning Yangbei slowed down and asked softly: "Little baby, why are you crying here alone? Where is your family?"
The child raised his head, looked at the four people with tearful eyes, and said with sobs: "I...my parents are both sick and unable to move in bed. I want to go up the mountain to pick some wild vegetables to feed them, but...but I can't find the wild vegetables, and I got lost. I'm afraid something will happen to my parents, and I want to go home..."
Before he finished speaking, the child couldn't help but burst into tears again, his voice choked with sobs, which made people feel sad.
Ning Yangbei felt even more compassion. He hurriedly knelt down, patted the child's back, and comforted him softly: "Don't cry, don't cry. We will take you home and help you take care of your parents. Do you know where your home is?"
Hearing this, the child's crying gradually stopped. He timidly pointed to a hut deep in the valley and nodded.
Zhang Zhongdong was enthusiastic and said immediately: "Let's send this child home first, and then check the condition of his parents. We can help him if we can."
Wang Xuenan and Chen Xuexi also have no objection. At this time when people are suffering, the four of them will never stand by and watch wherever they can help.
At the moment, Ning Yangbei held the child's hand, and the four of them walked towards the child's home together. In just half a stick of incense, I arrived at the child's home, which was an extremely dilapidated thatched hut.The earthen walls are mottled and the thatch on the roof is damaged in many places. When you push the door open, you will be greeted by a faint smell of medicine and illness.
The furnishings in the house were sparse, with only a dilapidated wooden bed. Lying on the bed was a middle-aged couple, both with sallow complexions, weak breaths, and coughing. They were dying of the plague that was ravaging the world.
The child threw himself beside the bed, crying for his parents, but he didn't have the strength to respond.
When Ning Yangbei saw this, he immediately walked to the bedside, raised his hand to activate the Qinglong Spirit Pearl, and a trace of warm Qingmu spiritual energy slowly injected into the couple's bodies. Wherever the spiritual energy passed, the couple's rapid coughing gradually subsided, their complexions improved slightly, and their breathing became much calmer.
"Thank you... thank you for the good Samaritan..." The man on the bed opened his eyes with difficulty and looked at Ning Yangbei, his eyes full of gratitude.
"You rest in peace, no need to be polite." Ning Yangbei said softly, and then took out all the dry food left in the four people's bags and put it on the table. "You can satisfy your hunger with these dry food first. We have to go west. If we have the opportunity, we will definitely come to visit you again in the future."
The four of them did not want to delay any longer. After all, the road to the west was long. If they stayed for one more moment, the people in the world would suffer for one more moment. But seeing the miserable appearance of this family of three, and feeling really uneasy, Wang Xuenan used what he had learned to find a few herbs in the house, crushed them and boiled them into a concoction, fed them to the couple, and carefully instructed the children on how to take care of their parents before preparing to say goodbye and leave.
Just when the four of them turned around to leave, there was suddenly an old coughing sound outside the house, and then, an old man in ragged clothes and gray hair staggered into the house, leaning on an old wooden stick.
The old man looked to be in his late teens, his clothes were shabby, his body was covered in dust, his face was withered, his eyes were cloudy, his legs seemed to be inconvenient, and he trembled when he walked, as if he could be blown over by a gust of wind.
"My dear friends, please do me a favor. The old man hasn't eaten for a few days, and he's caught the wind and cold. He's feeling uncomfortable all over. Could you please give me some food or some silver so that the old man can survive..." The old man walked up to the four of them and begged in a trembling voice, his voice weak and full of despair.
Seeing the miserable appearance of the old man, Zhang Zhongdong immediately felt kindhearted and wanted to hand over the remaining dry food. However, after touching his bag, he had already given all the dry food to the sick couple. The four of them had nothing to eat.
"Old man, I'm really sorry. We just gave all the dry food to this sick couple. We traveled westward without any money. It's really..." Zhang Zhongdong looked embarrassed and his tone was full of guilt.
When the old man heard this, his eyes became even more desperate. He slumped on the ground and cried loudly: "Heaven wants to kill me! The old man has no children and is sick. Now he can't even get a bite of food. It's better to just die!"
The old man cried pitifully, and those who heard it felt sad. Ning Yangbei couldn't bear it. He looked around and saw fish and shrimp swimming in the stream outside the house. He immediately said, "Don't worry, old man. Although we don't have dry food and silver, we can fish for you to satisfy your hunger and recuperate your body."
After that, Ning Yangbei took Zhang Zhongdong to the stream. Zhang Zhongdong used his magical power to roll up the stream water and drive the fish and shrimp to the shore. Ning Yangbei used the aura of green wood to protect the fish and shrimp and carefully caught them. Wang Xuenan found dry firewood in the house and made a fire to prepare for cooking. Chen Xuexi stood by the old man's side to prevent him from falling, and used his white tiger aura to dispel the cold in the old man's body.
The four of them worked hard for a long time without any complaints, and finally cooked the fish and shrimp and fed it to the old man one bite at a time. After the old man was full, Ning Yangbei activated the Qinglong spiritual energy to regulate the old man's body and relieve his pain.
The old man had eaten and drank enough, and his body felt much more comfortable. Looking at the busy figures of the four people, an imperceptible glint flashed in his turbid eyes, and then he returned to his frail appearance. He thanked him again and again: "Thank you four little friends. You are all really kind-hearted people. I can't thank you enough."The four people waved their hands quickly, saying it was a simple effort. When the old man's breath stabilized, the four of them said goodbye again and prepared to continue westward.
But as soon as he walked out of the hut, he saw a group of fierce-looking strong men standing at the intersection ahead, about ten or so of them, each holding a stick and looking evil, blocking the way of the four people.
The strong man in the lead had a sinewy face and fierce eyes. He stared at the four people and yelled: "Where do these young boys come from to dare to meddle in other people's business in this area? I drove this road and planted this tree. If you want to live this life, leave all valuable things behind you, otherwise, I will break your legs!"
